Kuwait’s Defence Ministry says two Italians have been killed after being injured by falling debris as authorities dealt with “Iranian hostile drones” in its airspace. Two other people injured in the incident have been taken to hospital.
In a call with his Kuwait counterpart, Iran’s Foreign Minister rejects claim Tehran was behind the attack.
